loss: Mean of per-class cross entropy (classes present) + 0.5 masked multiclass soft Dice. Mask 0/255 ignored.
augmentation: Class-balanced field sampling; random 256/384/512 source crop resampled to256, paired rotations90/flips, image-only gain0.6-1.6 and gamma0.8-1.2. RGB/255. Source files unchanged.
architecture: Context U-Net: four pooling levels, residual GroupNorm blocks, dilated bottom; 2073715 parameters.
checkpoint_selection: Highest mean tissue IoU on labelled root4 pixels; root4 is validation, not a final test.

baseline_metrics.scope: Only labelled pixels. Root4 same-slide development validation; not an independent test.

prediction_preprocessing: RGB/255. Overlapping 256px inference fields (128px stride,64px reflected image border,Hann probability blending) at original and half resolution; average probabilities. Training and inference field size matched. Fixed before this run. No reference-mask input or postprocessing.

additional_archived_slides.provenance: Archived human annotations from SALK backup; individual annotator not established. Only saved Periderm/Endoderm used; LR/conflicts ignored; unlabelled remains unlabelled.
